entry.title: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Nginx. Xint is reporting that it has discovered a collection of five critical vulnerabilities in the NGINX web server.
entry.summary:
Xint is reporting that it has discovered a collection of five critical vulnerabilities in the NGINX web server. The worst flaw, it says, would allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute commands on an affected nginx server with HTTP/2 enabled . The company also reports a local-privilege escalation (LPE) kernel vulnerability , which was introduced in the 4.15 kernel, in the Stream Control Transmission Protocol (SCTP) subsystem.

entry.title: MicroAssert: Microarchitecture-Aware Structured Assertion Generation for CPU Verification
entry.summary:
Automatic assertion generation reduces manual verification effort, yet existing approaches struggle to capture microarchitectural behaviors and cross-region interactions in CPUs. We present MicroAssert, a microarchitecture-aware framework that identifies functional regions directly from RTL and generates local and composite assertions through structured contracts and deterministic verification primitives. Coverage-guided feedback further improves verification completeness by progressively expanding proof-relevant RTL coverage.

Source: arXiv CS (PL, SE, DB, DC, DS) · Tags: #compilers #distributed-systems #computer-architecture #software-architecture
